name: pageSizes
label: Page sizes
description: Page size choices in the page size control

name: manageSelectedPage
label: Manage selected page
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the selected page property. Use the selected page set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: pageControlType
label: Page control type
description: Defines how the user selects a page. Choose 'buttons' to display page numbers as buttons, or 'input' to allow users to enter a page number manually

name: hideRange
label: Hide range
description: Select to hide text displaying the current range of the total number of records

name: hidePageNumbers
label: Hide page numbers
description: Select to hide page number buttons

name: visiblePages
label: Visible pages
description: Changes the number of pages that can be directly selected between arrows

name: hideGoToFirst
label: Hide first page button
description: Select to hide the "Go to first page" button

name: hideGoToPrevious
label: Hide previous page button
description: Select to hide the "Go to previous page" button

name: hideGoToNext
label: Hide next page button
description: Select to hide the "go to next page" button

name: hideGoToLast
label: Hide last page button
description: Select to hide the "Go to last page" button

name: selectedPageSize
label: Viewable items per page
description: Page size choice that is currently selected from the dropdown

name: manageSelectedPageSize
label: Manage selected page size
description: Enable this property to override automatic updates to the selected page size property. Use the selected page size set event to intercept the requested change and handle it manually

name: hidePageSizeControl
label: Hide viewable items control
description: Select to hide the page size control that allows the user to set a page size preference from a set of defined page size thresholds

name: hideInlinePadding
label: Hide padding
description: Select to hide the inline start and end padding
